core_obligations: Restrict to the case without particle-hole excitations and expand the kernel F-bar(x, p) in powers of epsilon, computing the first coefficients (proof lines 713-740).
Derive the epsilon-expansion of the new representation of Psi_nu from the displayed integral form (proof lines 741-770).

Run the induction on the order, tracking the contractions of the sigma_i with the powers of F-bar, identifying the missing singular term and replacing the regularised zeta function by zeta_0 (proof lines 771-891).
proof_roadmap: Setup, restriction and the epsilon-expansion of the kernel (proof lines 713-740).
Epsilon-expansion of the new representation (proof lines 741-770).
Induction on the order and identification of the singular term (proof lines 771-891).
difficulty_reason: H3：463-474、713-891把TBA-derived Psi的epsilon expansion转成bosonic-current exponential representation；以generating coefficients u_(n,m)重组无限formal sums计算全部contractions，再用S(h)S(-h)=1的duality将每阶缺失singular terms补齐于作者原式，闭合all-orders induction。难点为nonlinear TBA formal series与operator-exponential对应及singular/regular pieces cancellation，不以公式篇幅判H3。作者appendix明确为简化取无particle-hole excitations，原章节general proposition含E(s,p)；保留作者这项scope说明，不额外声称本轮认证一般激发推广。
